newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares down at noon on correction.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares down at noon on correction.

text.p: Shanghai's B share index was down at midday on Tuesday on a technical correction after sharp gains over the past few trading days, brokers said.
The B index fell 0.576 points or 0.66 percent to 86.954 points on volume of 18.34 million shares worth $10.591 million, compared with $14.786 million on Monday morning.

A technical correction is necessary to digest profit-taking, but market sentiment is still good, brokers said, adding that if the index does not fall sharply in the afternoon, it could test another new high in the short term.
"Both domestic and overseas investors have confidence in the market outlook despite today's correction," one broker said. "They regard it as a rest before further rises."
"Most company's 1996 results have not yet been issued, and many are expected to show poor performance, which have have a negative impact on the market," another broker said.
Of total 43 B shares, 41 traded, with 30 down, three flat and eight up.
Shanghai Automation Instrument was the biggest loser on profit-taking, down $0.014 or 5.55 percent to $0.238 on volume of 624,000 shares.
Shanghai Lujiazui Finance & Trade Zone Development was the most actively traded, down $0.004 or 0.31 percent to $1.280 on volume of 1.4 million shares.
Shanghai's A shares were up on bullish sentiment, brokers said. The index rose 5.165 points or 0.36 percent to 1,429.271 points on volume of 457 million shares worth 5.5 billion yuan.
The SSE30 index edged up 3.857 points or 0.10 percent to 3,686.193 points.
Jiangxi Paper was the star on institutional speculative buying, surging 1.46 yuan or 10.00 percent to 16.05 yuan on volume of 14.6 million shares.
